infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: yesman requests Bluetooth access for device tasks you choose to run. No devices are scanned or connected when granting access.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: yesman requests microphone access for audio tasks you choose to run. Granting access does not start recording.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: yesman requests camera access for capture tasks you choose to run. Granting access does not capture images.
